integrity: A direct forcing-sequence-to-matching proof and an inductive tree-interface proof establish the stated quantifiers. Numerical tests are corroboration and not substitutes for these proofs. The definition of uniquely restricted matching and prior special-family enumerators are attributed to their published sources.
scientific_limitations: The arbitrary-base characterization is existential. Polynomial-time all-coefficient evaluation is proved only for forest bases; the no-even-cycle Hall simplification by itself is not accompanied by a general polynomial-time enumerator. Verification is finite, covering base graphs through six vertices; implicit earlier formulations remain possible.
title: Power domination of leaf coronas through uniquely restricted matchings
